newsitem.title: USA: Smith victory now seen in New Hampshire.
newsitem.headline: Smith victory now seen in New Hampshire.

text.p: New Hampshire Republican Sen. Bob Smith won his re-election bid to Democrat Dick Swett, a switch in outcome based on larger election returns, according to revised network television projections Wednesday.

Soon after the state's polls closed Tuesday evening, television networks projected a narrow victory for Swett. However, a later count showed Smith to be victorious and prevented Swett from becoming the first Democratic senator from the state in 21 years. The state, usually a reliable Republican stronghold, also voted for President Clinton.
